page: Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the Edsv6 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz. The processor includes a 260 MB L3 cache and supports advanced instruction sets such as Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and integer operations. This server is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32 GB per vCPU. Storage is provided via 7559 GB of local disk space, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark data indicates strong performance in specific memory and throughput-bound workloads. The server achieves a strong rating in large-block memory bandwidth, with read-only speeds of 238.84 GB/sec and write speeds of 137.13 GB/sec. In computational tests, the Passmark CPU physics test scored in the top 25% at 7302.83, while the overall Passmark CPU score of 47316.29 falls within the average range. Static web serving throughput is strong at 44.43 GB/sec. For small and medium language model inference, the system demonstrates strong prompt processing speeds, reaching 2558.78 tokens/sec for a 135M model and 179.21 tokens/sec for a 7B model, though text generation for the 7B model drops to an average tier of 19.63 tokens/sec.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the E128-32ds_v6 offers high resource density, particularly regarding its memory-to-core ratio and large local storage capacity. This profile makes it suitable for memory-intensive applications that do not require massive parallel CPU scaling but benefit from large memory footprints and local scratch space. Appropriate workloads include large relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
description: The Microsoft Azure E128-32ds_v6 is an x86_64 memory-optimized server from the Edsv6 family, powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor with 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores) running at 4.2 GHz. It features 1024.0 GB of RAM, providing a high 32 GB per vCPU ratio, and includes 7559 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. Benchmark results show strong performance in large-block memory bandwidth, static web serving throughput, and prompt processing for small to medium language models, while general CPU and database operations perform in the average tier. Lacking a GPU, this server is designed for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads. It is highly suited for large databases, in-memory data stores, and data-intensive enterprise applications requiring substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.
